Own older + foreign newer: previous_kind foreign, own_previous_handoff, carry_notice, next_ids = max over both files + 1, newer_foreign without the base, foreign_commits based on the own file; the stage records the carry; begin JSON <= 3,072 B (AT-CF-06). Publish lint: a foreign line without a [from …] tag is carry-provenance; a tagged approval marked used is carry-approval; tagged lines with the context-only note publish, and the frontmatter carries previous_kind and own_previous_handoff
